name: Hikari Musubi
description: A quiet, elegant theme for small wedding planners: an ivory ground with blush bands, champagne hairlines and one mauve-brown accent, Gloock headings and Public Sans text, and a mizuhiki knot (a tied paper cord between two fine lines) as the divider throughout; a header that is only the wordmark and a Menu button opening a full-screen menu; a home page that reads as one long single column, from a letter by the planner to the plans and the venues; a footer that is one quiet line; with about, plans and prices, a gallery, venues, a journal, a newsletter and contact. The studio details and the plans with their prices are each edited in one place.

fonts.role: headings, the wordmark, the open menu, plan names and prices
body text, labels, navigation, forms and buttons
